rv.q: This superbly acted production, transferred to 59E59 Theaters from Theater J in Washington, makes a fascinating case for trying anyway.
Ultimately, you emerge from the theatre buzzy from ideas, dizzy from the plot, fizzy from the entertainment.
But with the most compelling bits of This Much I Know stuck in the realm of academia, it falls short of being a perfectly controlled experiment.
Drama , Reviews Jonathan Spector’s This Much I Know is an erudite, ambitious, and wide-ranging play in the vein of Tom Stoppard.

cn.t: Spector's ambitious, erudite play about cognition and behavior challenges audiences with its intellectual scope. Critics find it tantalizing if occasionally baffling, praising its Stoppardian range but noting it demands patience.
